summary.headline: Astrological Weaknesses and Effects
summary.text: Continuation of a classification of astrological weaknesses, listing twenty-two lowest-rank effects—including planetary settings and risings, opposition, eighth house, apogee and perigee points, slaughter, lunar inauspiciousness, cutting off of light, refraction, nodes, harmful planetary configurations, and the cutting lot—followed by nine highest-rank intermediate effects and thirteen middle-rank effects beginning with the deferent’s quarter and latitude.
